summary: Recorded the ordering between membership acceptance and the raft layer's membership maps. A committed config change is first admitted or rejected by the replicated state machine's membership object, then node.ApplyConfigChange takes the raft mutex, forwards only accepted changes so remotes/observers/witnesses change, and always reports the outcome so the pending-config-change gate is cleared or the change is marked rejected; a self-removal also drops the cluster from the registry and requests local removal. Added the node and raft-layer source anchors. No new question and no execution this turn.
